info.name: 📌 Replicate API
info.description:
### About Replicate

"Run open-source machine learning models with a cloud API"

Replicate hosts thousands of community and official models, from image and video generation to LLMs, behind one prediction API. On the workspace overview it is listed under **Image & video**.

### Prerequisites

- Postman Account
    
- Replicate Account: [https://replicate.com/](https://replicate.com/)
    

### Usage

1. Create a fork
    
2. Update collection variables
    
3. Send requests

Start with the 🚀 Get Started folder.

Add your key to your **Postman Vault** as `replicate_api_key` (Vault icon in the footer, then **Add secret**, using that exact name). Requests read it as `{{vault:replicate_api_key}}`, so your key never leaves your device.

### Documentation

- API: [https://replicate.com/docs/reference/http](https://replicate.com/docs/reference/http)
    
- Models: [https://replicate.com/explore#collections](https://replicate.com/explore#collections)
